permissions.name: tax:view
permissions.description: See whether tax is connected, where tax is being collected, and the rate table

permissions.name: tax:calculate
permissions.description: Ask what tax is owed on a set of items over the API

permissions.name: tax:record
permissions.description: Record a completed sale in the tax ledger, or reverse one that was refunded

permissions.name: tax:rates
permissions.description: Add, edit and end the rates in the rate table, and run the home-state quick start

permissions.name: tax:reports
permissions.description: See the tax ledger and the reports built from it, and export them

permissions.name: tax:settings
permissions.description: Change the tax provider, its API key, the home location and the defaults

settings.name: provider
settings.description: Which engine works out the tax: 'rates' (a table you maintain) or 'stripe' (Stripe Tax)

settings.name: currency
settings.description: The currency amounts are in when the caller does not name one. ISO 4217, lowercase

settings.name: prices_include_tax
settings.description: Whether the prices passed in already contain tax (VAT-style). Off means tax is added on top (US-style)

settings.name: default_tax_code
settings.description: The Stripe tax category (txcd_…) used for an item that does not name one. Blank uses the default set in the Stripe dashboard

settings.name: shipping_tax_code
settings.description: The Stripe tax category used for shipping charges. Blank uses Stripe's own shipping category

settings.name: stripe_secret_key
settings.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_… or sk_live_…). Encrypted at rest and never sent to a browser. Blank falls back to the key kempo-payments holds, if it is installed

settings.name: default_tax_class
settings.description: The tax class used for an item whose caller names none (rate table provider)

settings.name: home_country
settings.description: Two-letter country code of where you are based, such as US. Used to warn when a sale at home is recorded with no tax collected

settings.name: home_state
settings.description: State or region you are based in, as the same code your checkout sends (such as VT)

settings.name: home_city
settings.description: City you are based in. Only used for origin-sourced states

settings.name: home_postal
settings.description: Postal code you are based in. Only used for origin-sourced states

settings.name: rounding
settings.description: How tax is rounded: 'line' rounds each line's tax, 'invoice' rounds once per tax layer for the whole sale

settings.name: origin_sourcing_states
settings.description: Comma-separated states that tax a sale to the seller's own state by where the seller is, not where the buyer is. Leave blank for destination sourcing

groups.name: kempo-tax:viewer
groups.description: Can see whether tax is connected, the rate table, the ledger and the reports, without being able to change anything

groups.name: kempo-tax:bookkeeper
groups.description: Everything a viewer can do, plus recording and reversing sales — what an accountant or an order system acts as

groups.name: kempo-tax:administrator
groups.description: Everything, including the rate table, the provider and its key
